item.title: EU auditors sound alarm over billions in COVID recovery funds that can’t be clearly traced
item.summary: European auditors say they can't clearly trace billions of euros spent from a massive fund meant to help EU countries recover from COVID-19

item.title: Family fears for jailed Iranian Nobel Peace laureate's life if she's not moved to a Tehran hospital
item.summary: Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi is in critical condition in an Iranian hospital

item.title: Sweden detains sanctioned oil tanker believed to be linked to Russia's shadow fleet
item.summary: Sweden's coast guard has detained a tanker suspected of being part of Russia’s so-called “shadow fleet.”

item.title: French carrier group moves south of Suez ahead of conditional UK-French Hormuz mission
item.summary: The French armed forces say that France’s aircraft carrier strike group is moving south of the Suez Canal and into the Red Sea in preparation for a potential future mission as part of a French-British plan for the Strait of Hormuz

item.title: Bus and oil tanker collide in Indonesia, killing at least 16 people
item.summary: A passenger bus has collided with a fuel tanker truck on Indonesia's Sumatra island, killing at least 16 people and injuring four others

item.title: Pope Leo XIV comforts 13 priests from southern Lebanon with surprise video call
item.summary: Pope Leo XIV has surprised 13 priests from southern Lebanon with a video call from Rome

item.title: Pope will inaugurate Barcelona's Sagrada Familia tower and meet with migrants in June trip to Spain
item.summary: Pope Leo XIV will inaugurate the central tower of Barcelona’s Sagrada Familia basilica during his visit to Spain next month

item.title: China is stepping up its Iran war diplomacy ahead of Trump's summit with Xi
item.summary: China’s diplomatic role in the Iran war has come into sharper focus after talks between Chinese and Iranian foreign ministers on Wednesday, days before U.S. President Donald Trump is expected to meet his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping

item.title: Protest groups block access to Russian pavilion at Venice Biennale
item.summary: Members of punk group Pussy Riot and Ukraine's FEMEN organization have staged a protest at the Russian pavilion at the Venice Biennale

item.title: Poland warns Russia is moving from low-cost recruits to professional sabotage cells
item.summary: Poland's internal security service has warned that Russia is shifting from using individual recruits to ‘professional’ networks to carry out a campaign of sabotage across Europe
